MasulloGRH.genuineSpectralJet_coefficient_action.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ)
  (hcφ : HasCompactSupport φ) (χ : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (z : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  have ℓ := genuineClassLog K ⋯;
  have ψ := genuineNormTwist K χ z;
  Integrable (fun g => φ g * genuineSpectralJet K χ z m (g * x)) μ ∧
    ∫ (g : HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g * genuineSpectralJet K χ z m (g * x) ∂μ =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), jetMoment K μ φ ψ ℓ j * (genuineSpectralJet K χ z (m - j) x * ↑(m.choose j))

  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (φ f : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hcφ : HasCompactSupport φ)
  (χ : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (z : ℂ) (m : ℕ)
  (hjoint : Integrable (fun p => φ (p.1 * p.2⁻¹) * f p.2 * genuineSpectralJet K χ z m p.1) (μ.prod μ)) :
  have ℓ := genuineClassLog K ⋯;
  have ψ := genuineNormTwist K χ z;
  Integrable (fun x => ideleClassConvolution K μ φ f x * genuineSpectralJet K χ z m x) μ ∧
    ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ideleClassConvolution K μ φ f x * genuineSpectralJet K χ z m x ∂μ =
      ∫ (y : HeckeIdeleClasses K),
        f y *
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), jetMoment K μ φ ψ ℓ j * (genuineSpectralJet K χ z (m - j) y * ↑(m.choose j)) ∂μ
